teapot_risk: Mrs. Potts from Disney's Beauty and the Beast if it gets a face or steam smile; the Utah (Newell) teapot of 3D graphics if the profile is the stock squat teapot; blue-and-white china (Willow, Delft, Wedgwood) if the blue grows into a pattern; Pokemon Sinistea.
teapot_fix: Keep it faceless and hand-drawn, with its own slightly lopsided shape and a round lid with no stock knob. The single blue dot under the lid is the only blue: no patterns, no china motifs, no steam face, and a name that is none of the above.
moth_risk: Mothra from the Godzilla films and Pokemon moths (Venomoth, Butterfree, Volcarona) through big eyespot wings; the logo of The Moth, the storytelling group; the death's-head hawkmoth skull; and generic bookworm mascots. Wing 'writing' that copies a real script, a sacred text or a real book would be a harmful caricature or a copying problem.
moth_fix: Keep it small, round and soft, with no eyespots, skull, glowing eyes or battle look. Draw the wing writing as invented, unreadable scribble lines that are no real alphabet, no real words and no pseudo-Asian or pseudo-Arabic lettering. Give it its own name and its one circle round the Lamp before landing.
to_codex: Keep the teapot faceless, hand-drawn, lopsided, one blue dot only; no Mrs. Potts, Utah-teapot profile or china patterns.
to_claude: Wings: invented scribble marks, no real script, eyespots or skull; stay round and soft, not Mothra, Pokemon, The Moth.
